name: Thung Nham Bird Park
kicker: Bird valley and caves in a karst basin
summary: Karst valley where thousands of egrets and storks roost: boat out to the bird island and climb to a cave. It is about 5 km west of Bích Động and needs its own ticket. Go when you want birds and caves on top of the boat. Skip it if the Tam Cốc ride is your only day.
getThere: About 5 km west of Bích Động by road
heroCaption: Egrets roosting in the trees of the bird island, below the karst

notice.title: A separate ticket
notice.body: The Tam Cốc boat ticket does not cover Thung Nham. It has its own ticket and phone line.

body: Thung Nham is a basin of more than 40 ha in the Hoa Lư forest, ringed by limestone. The bird garden covers more than 300 ha and holds about 40,000 birds of 46 species, from egrets and night herons to the open-billed storks in the trees. The boatman stops at a distance from the bird island so you can watch.

The caves are the other half of the visit. Động Vái Giời, the largest, sits up 439 stone steps and has three levels across about 5,000 m². Động Tiên Cá is a water cave of more than 1,500 m that you walk on a bamboo raft walkway.
An electric car runs the whole route, and there is a pool with its own price. Pair it with Bích Động, about 5 km east.

figures.caption: Open-billed storks in the bird garden
figures.alt: Open-billed storks perched on bare branches, one landing with wings spread, at Thung Nham

gettingThere: Thung Nham is in the Hải Nham valley, about 5 km west of Bích Động pagoda by road. Inside the site, hire a bicycle or take the boat to the bird garden.

legs.heading: Inside the park
legs.body: A boat or a hired bicycle to the bird garden, or the electric car for the whole route at 40,000 VND a person.

admissionNote: Adult 250,000 VND, child 1–1.3 m 150,000 VND, under 1 m free. Electric car for the whole route 40,000 VND a person. Pool: adult 100,000 VND, child 1–1.3 m 50,000 VND. This ticket is separate from the Tam Cốc ticket.
